meta.kick_test: after convergence: kick all above-floor weights by (1 + 1e-3 xi) and re-equilibrate (<= 3 times) until clusters stop changing
meta.populated: major cluster (>= 1% of neurons) whose support is a stable part and centroid cosine > 0.98
meta.c_rank: 0 = stable part with the largest Perron eigenvalue c
